themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Missed trash collection complaints surged to 10 THIS WEEK, a 627% spike from the 1.4 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.08), suggesting a systemic sanitation breakdown affecting multiple blocks in Riverdale.
evidence: 10 missed collection complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (627% increase)
Z-score of 7.08 indicates statistically significant deviation
Parallel spike in illegal dumping (9 complaints last week vs. 2.9 avg, +213%) suggests residents disposing of waste elsewhere
reporting_angles: Identify affected blocks and interview residents about overflowing bins; contact Sanitation Department about staffing or route disruptions
Investigate whether missed collections are triggering secondary complaints (illegal dumping, unsanitary conditions, rodent/pest issues)

themes_detail.label: Pigeon Infestation Outbreak
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary pigeon condition complaints exploded to 4 LAST WEEK, a 1500% spike from the 0.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.66, highest severity), indicating a potential citywide or localized pest crisis.
evidence: 4 pigeon complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1500% increase)
Highest z-score of all spikes at 8.66, indicating most extreme statistical anomaly
Spike occurred alongside overgrown tree/branches complaints (3 last week vs. 0.5 avg, +500%), suggesting habitat conditions enabling infestation
reporting_angles: Canvass affected neighborhoods to map infestation geography; interview affected residents and local business owners about impact on quality of life
Investigate whether Parks Department tree maintenance backlog is creating roosting sites; check if Health Department is tracking outbreak

themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Dangling street signs spiked to 5 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 1900% increase from the 0.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.18), alongside street condition complaints (732 over 90 days), suggesting deteriorating public infrastructure.
evidence: 5 dangling street sign complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1900% increase)
Z-score of 7.18 indicates significant statistical anomaly
Street condition remains high-volume complaint category (732 over 90 days), suggesting underlying maintenance crisis
reporting_angles: Conduct visual inventory of dangling/damaged signage in identified complaint areas; document safety hazards for drivers and pedestrians
Interview DOT about maintenance backlog and resource constraints; connect to CB budget requests for traffic and pedestrian safety improvements

themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints jumped to 9 LAST WEEK, a 213% spike from the 2.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 3.62), coinciding with the missed garbage collection crisis and suggesting environmental cleanup costs shifting to residents.
evidence: 9 illegal dumping complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (213% increase)
Spike temporally aligned with missed collection crisis, suggesting causal link
Unsanitary condition category remains elevated (441 over 90 days), indicating compounding contamination
reporting_angles: Map dumping hotspots and interview residents about whether missed collections are driving illegal disposal; document environmental impact
Investigate enforcement response: how many dumping complaints result in citations or cleanup? Contact Sanitation Enforcement

themes_detail.label: Unlicensed Street Vending
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints spiked to 3 LAST WEEK, a 700% increase from the 0.4 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.42), suggesting a potential illegal street vending expansion or enforcement gap in Riverdale.
evidence: 3 vendor enforcement complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% increase)
Z-score of 5.42 indicates statistically significant spike
No corroborating news mentions or community board escalations yet, limiting contextual understanding
reporting_angles: Identify affected commercial corridors; interview business owners and residents about vending activity and impact on foot traffic or public space
Contact NYPD and city vendor enforcement about why this spike occurred; determine if it reflects new vending activity or increased complaint rate
